div.div: مَغَرٌ and ↓ مُغْرَةٌ (K, TA) A colour inclining to red: (TA:) or a colour not pure red, (K, TA,) nor inclining to yellow; its redness being like the colour of ↓ مَغْرَة : (TA:) or i. q. شُقْرَةٌ [i. e., in a man, ruddiness of complexion combined with fairness, and in a horse, a sorrel colour,] with duskiness, or dinginess. (K.) See also أَمْغَرُ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
